name: Coronavirus
title: SARS-CoV-2
caption: Real SARS-CoV-2 particles seen by transmission electron microscopy. The warm-colored particles stand out against surrounding material; the colors were added by NIAID.
alt: Color-enhanced electron micrograph of rounded SARS-CoV-2 particles, shown in orange and pink against a blue background.

name: Influenza A
title: Influenza A
caption: A group of real influenza A particles. Compare their rounded outlines and fine surface projections with the simplified illustration.
alt: Grayscale transmission electron micrograph of many rounded influenza A particles with fine projections around their edges.

name: Adenovirus
title: Adenovirus
caption: Two real adenovirus particles. Their angular outlines hint at the faceted capsid; a micrograph does not reveal every feature as clearly as a drawing.
alt: Grayscale electron micrograph showing two adenovirus particles with roughly polygonal outlines.

name: Rabies virus
title: Rabies virus
caption: Rabies particles within infected tissue. Look for the small elongated, bullet-shaped profiles. The larger structures belong to the cell or its viral inclusions.
alt: Grayscale thin-section electron micrograph of infected tissue containing numerous small elongated rabies particles and larger cellular structures.

name: Tobacco mosaic virus
title: Tobacco mosaic virus
caption: Real tobacco mosaic virus particles show long, straight rods. The white scale bar represents 100 nanometers. Dark staining helps make the particles visible.
credit: International Committee on Taxonomy of Viruses
alt: Grayscale electron micrograph of long, straight tobacco mosaic virus rods, with a white 100-nanometer scale bar.

name: T4 bacteriophage
title: T4 bacteriophage
caption: A real T4 particle with a large head, a long tail, and fine fibers near its base. This photograph is naturally grainier than the teaching illustration.
alt: Black-and-white electron micrograph of a T4 bacteriophage showing its head, tail, and thin attachment fibers.
